images.caption: Figure A1:Family-level capability profile.Family medians (a) and task-wise best scores within each family (b); the latter may come from different models. MM-EG averages five L3 endpoints; L6 uses the CarePath cohort. Per-model results appear in Table1and Fig.A2.
Figure A2:Model performance by clinical capability.Scores follow Table1; gray cells denote unavailable interfaces. L6 uses the CarePath cohort, and L3 uses its static-image cohorts.

Figure A3:L3 evidence-grounding diagnostics.Panels (a,b,d) use the 100-case anatomical panel; panel (c) uses the GPT-OSS-120B text-stager experiment.(a)Direct T-stage accuracy can diverge from class-balanced T recall.(b)Base-structure localization does not guarantee correct structure-plus-invasion evidence.(c)When gold 18-structure evidence is supplied, a fixed GPT-OSS-120B stager nearly reaches the rule ceiling; when model-generated evidence is supplied, LLM-slot T-stage scores remain much lower. Reference shows gold-evidence LLM-slot accuracy and balanced recall, with no direct-image prediction.(d)Per-stage recall shows uneven recognition of the four T categories.
